confidence_notes: Medium overall. Meal anchors agree reasonably across Numbeo and several 2026 Bangkok price guides, though mid-range dinner figures vary widely. Beer, cocktail and wine rest on travel and nightlife guide ranges; wine figures mostly come from bar and rooftop listings, so cocktail and wine were sanity-checked against the beer anchor (roughly 3x). Coffee relies mainly on one 2026 Bangkok listing, with Thailand-wide ranges as a cross-check. THB prices were converted at about 33 THB per USD, not a live rate, and the sources are 2026-dated rather than specific to July 2026. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, with no accommodation search or listing check, making them the least certain values.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city substituted. Food and drink anchors use Bangkok-specific price sources, with Thailand-wide ranges as a cross-check. Accommodation anchors are holistic Bangkok tier estimates from general knowledge of the Southeast Asian hostel and hotel market.
